description: per-environment values keep their YAML types; they are not forwarded

inputs_json.environments-yml:
- environment: "env-a"
  format-check-in-root-dir: false
  terraform-version: 1.5
  pr-auto-merge-enabled: true
  add-pr-comment: "false"
inputs_json.pr-auto-merge-limits-yml:
plan-max-count-add: 0
plan-max-count-change: 0
plan-max-count-destroy: 0
plan-max-count-import: -1
plan-max-count-move: -1
plan-max-count-remove: 0

engine_expected.deviation: a per-environment value for a string input must be a string, since YAML reads an unquoted 1.10 as 1.1; per-environment booleans become the gates' strings (per-env-yaml-types-v1)
errors: The environment 'env-a' sets 'terraform-version' to 1.5, which is not a string; quote it!
